card.name: Final piece of injectable brand names
card.fires_on: The last piece of an injectable or infused brand-name drug, such as ENHERTU or IMFINZI, in dosage sections. The next word is usually a dose or a route like 'is for subcutaneous injection'.

modes.label: Brand name before a dose
modes.description: Final piece of a capitalized brand name directly followed by a dose amount.

modes.label: Brand name before route or administration
modes.description: Final piece of a brand name followed by how it is given, such as infusion or subcutaneous use.
modes.example: EPKIN<<LY>> is for subcutaneous injection only.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like injection and injected after an injectable drug name.
card.plain: It fires at the end of an injectable brand name in dosing text, anticipating the word injection.
evidence: EPKIN<<LY>> is for subcutaneous injection only.
